title: Zoning in four steps

captions.instagram:
Zoning is the rulebook behind every city building. It decides use, density, what improvements are possible and which approvals you need.

The order I'd work in: use analysis, approval strategy, feasibility, team.

General guidance, not legal advice.

#RealEstate #Zoning #UrbanDevelopment

What's your zoning story?
captions.facebook:
Before you buy a property, read the rulebook. Zoning decides what it can become. I broke it into four things it controls and four steps to check.

General guidance, not legal advice.

#Zoning #RealEstate

Have zoning rules ever surprised you?
captions.linkedin:
Know the rules before you buy, not after.

Zoning decides four things about a site: how land and buildings can be used, how much can be built, what improvements are possible, and what approvals a project needs.

The order I'd work in: use analysis, approval strategy, feasibility, then the team. Without that check, surprises arrive after purchase. With it, plans are designed to fit.

General guidance, not legal advice. Work with qualified land use professionals.

#Zoning #RealEstate

What's the most surprising zoning rule you've run into?
